title: Caught Object Report JSON
description: A JS caught object representation. Default implementation is https://www.npmjs.com/package/caught-object-report-json.

BASE_PROPERTIES_MIXIN.description: Base properties shared by all report objects. This is the complete form of corj/v0.11: the default implementation produces it with `omitExpectedValues: false`, and `restoreExpectedValues` converts a corj/v0.11 report into it. No field is omitted for holding its expected value.

truncated.description: Present when content or child reports were omitted to meet the configured whole-report size limit. On the root of an array report, this flag applies to the entire array.

instanceof_error.description: Required base property. Result of `caught instanceof Error`.

typeof.description: Required base property. Result of `typeof caught`.

constructor_name.description: Optional base property. Result of `caught.constructor.name`. Not set if `caught` does not have a `constructor.name`. Set to `null` if accessing `caught.constructor.name` throws.

message.description: Optional base property. Result of `caught.message`. Not set if `caught` does not have a `message`. Set to `null` if accessing `caught.message` throws.

as_string.description: Required base property. String representation of `caught` created using the format in `as_string_format` described in this schema. Set to `null` if creating string representation throws.

as_json.description: Required base property. JSON representation of `caught` created using the format in field `as_json_format` described in this schema. The default implementation shares a configurable whole-report size budget across all fields and children (100,000 UTF-8 bytes by default) and marks partial values with [caught-object-report-json: Truncated]. Set to `null` if creating JSON representation throws.

stack.description: Optional base property. Result of `caught.stack`. Not set if `caught` does not have a string `stack`. Set to `null` if accessing `caught.stack` throws. The default implementation stores `stack.split("\n")` as an array of lines (`parseStackToArray`, on by default); the raw string is stored when that option is off.

children_omitted_reason.description: Optional base property. Is set if this `caught` object has fields reported in `children_sources`, but they were omitted by implementation.

v.description: Optional base property. Metadata property. A version of report, can be omitted. `corj/v0.11-full` marks a complete report.

as_string_format.description: Optional base property. Metadata property. A format of `as_string` field, can be omitted.

as_json_format.description: Optional base property. Metadata property. A format of `as_json` field, can be omitted.

children_sources.description: Optional base property. Metadata property. Array of property names of caught object to collect into `children` property.

children.description: Optional top-level property. Children collected from `children_sources`, tree flattened to array. This is different from `children` property for nested reports.

id.description: Required array-element property. Integer id unique for this report.

path.description: Required array-element property. JSONPath from top-level caught object.

level.description: Required array-element property. Level of this object in the tree of nested error objects. Top-level is 0.

children.description: Optional array-element property. Array of children ids. This is different from `children` property for top-level object.
